drhp.business: The Company designs, crafts, and wholesale-supplies high-end gold, diamond, and precious gemstone jewellery to leading retail chains and regional distributors across India, operating as a B2B supply chain partner offering custom design development, rapid sample prototyping, and scalable bulk production for enterprise retail clients. Its product portfolio spans 100% BIS-hallmarked 22K/18K plain gold, Kundan, antique temple, and certified studded diamond jewellery, made using CAD-CAM 3D prototyping and modern casting technology combined with traditional craftsmanship.
